messages.subject: Project Falcon - our mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached. The key moves: (1) availability up from 97.5% to 98.0%; (2) liability cap up from 125% to 150% of trailing Charges and the supply super-cap from £15m to £20m; and (3) payment terms out from 30 to 45 days. The rest is largely tidy-up. Happy to take a call this week.

Adam
Denham Lewis LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena - Denham Lewis mark-up in. They've gone to 98% availability, 150% cap / £20m super-cap and 45-day payment. I think we can give ground on availability (97.75%) and the cap (135% / £17.5m) but should hold the line at 30-day payment. Will discuss with Helena before we respond. Internal only please.

James
